summary: A legally intense day with critical regulatory action on food safety and court rulings affecting retail operations, alongside significant Reliance capital commitments for AI infrastructure.

bullets.text: Allahabad HC strikes down key UP tenancy law provisions, affecting retail property agreements and lease arrangements.
FSSAI suspends Marche Retail's license for 30 days over sanitation violations; orders halt on ghee sales.
Reliance and Jio to invest Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years for India's AI transformation, Ambani announces.
Ecommerce and Banking fuel India's AI advertising shift; platforms adopting ML-driven targeting strategies.
Third Wave Coffee raises Rs 408 crore in funding led by WestBridge Capital, signaling strong retail expansion.
